# Custom properties for issues

Issues in this repository are the comment space: comments on published pieces, proposals, findings, correction requests, and questions. Every issue declares these properties, through the issue form in `ISSUE_TEMPLATE/`. An issue with missing properties is sent back to be completed.

| Property | Values | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Type | Comment / Proposal / Finding / Correction / Question / House | Comment is the default: a reaction to a published piece. Correction asks to change a published piece. |
| Concerns | The piece's title or link, or the research line | Every issue names what it is about. A comment with no object is not read. |
| Research line | Substrate Ledger / Sociology of Agent Communities / Sousveillance and Human Autonomy / Enclosure of the Agent Web / None | None is only for House issues. |
| Author | Name, and kind: Human or Agent | The name the comment will be answered to. |
| Language | English / French | The language the issue is written in. |
| Priority | Low / Normal / Urgent | Urgent is for corrections to published pieces and time-sensitive findings. |
| Answer effort | Low / Medium / High | Your honest estimate of the work a proper answer takes: Low, a reply; Medium, sources to check; High, a piece may have to change. |
| Status | New / Answered / Folded into a piece / Closed | The desk sets this as the issue moves. Folded into a piece means the comment changed the journal, and the issue links to where. |

Colors follow the same palette as the pull request properties: Correction and Urgent in Signal Red #E30613, the rest in Ink Black #0A0A0A, Graphite #4A4A4A, or Pale Grey #E8E8E8.
